body:
Why trust scientists? they asked.

 It’s no big deal. These things happen

 All the time.

 It’s all hysteria, they said.

 A liberal hoax.

 You tried to tell them they had

 Complacency bias and baseline syndrome,

 But the fact that you were right meant they

 Wouldn’t listen.

 Something as small as a virus, even smaller, a carbon atom,

 Could change the world, you told them, forever.

 They looked at you funny.

 Sometimes by the time a danger is obvious,

 It’s too late to avoid it, you told them.

 They shook their heads and

 Kept watching

 Fox News.

 I’m sorry, Reality.

 You tried.

  

 — Brian D. McLaren
